stem:
A block of mass *m* oscillates vertically on a spring, as shown in Fig. 4.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The acceleration *a* of the block varies with displacement *x* from its equilibrium position, as shown in Fig. 4.2.

[[fig:f2]]

The amplitude of the oscillations is 3Y and the maximum acceleration is 2A.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how Fig. 4.2 shows that the oscillations of the block are simple harmonic.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead: Deduce expressions, in terms of some or all of *m*, *A* and *Y*, for:
parts.text: the angular frequency *ω* of the oscillations

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: the maximum speed *v₀* of the oscillations

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The period of the oscillations is 0.75 s and the value of 3Y is 1.8 cm.

Determine an expression for *x* in terms of time *t*, where *x* is in cm and *t* is in seconds.

figures.caption: Fig. 4.1
figures.alt: A block hangs from a vertical spring, with an arrow showing oscillations about its equilibrium position.

figures.caption: Fig. 4.2
figures.alt: A straight-line graph of acceleration a against displacement x slopes downward from 2A at −3Y to −2A at 3Y, crossing the origin.
